test_cases.name: fetch-with-url
test_cases.description: Fetch PR comments using full GitHub URL (most reliable method)
test_cases.expected_output: Output contains 'Found' and 'pending comment(s)' with ID, file path, and author
test_cases.notes: Specific comment count and file names depend on current PR state

test_cases.name: fetch-with-explicit-args
test_cases.description: Fetch PR comments using explicit owner/repo/PR format
test_cases.expected_output: Output format matches test case 1 (same PR, different input format)
test_cases.notes: Validates that different input formats produce equivalent results

test_cases.name: fetch-from-project-directory
test_cases.description: Fetch PR comments using PR number from a git repository directory
test_cases.expected_output: Output matches test case 1 when PR number is valid for repo context
test_cases.notes: Requires TEST_REPO_OWNER and TEST_REPO_NAME to match current directory's repository
